hypothesis: Typed whole-task correspondence and durable effect/outbox recovery improve reliability and repeated-call counts when task handoffs fail; changing invisible wire syntax alone cannot change a model's information.
primary_contrast: Original plain handoff behavior versus checked durable coordination. Improvements are attributed to validation/recovery mechanisms, not Rust syntax.
mechanism_control: The same checked effect ledger over JSON must match the protocol's semantic outcome. This control identifies whether the benefit needs the custom wire representation.

native_execution.policy: Workers receive task semantics and tool instructions, not computed assessments or completed message templates. Assessor requests findings through the actual host/MCP gateway; reviewer must inspect its received handoff and retrieve the referenced finding. No answer is supplied by the coordinator. No live-result-dependent repair or rescore.

fixed_semantics.sample_pass: Both target correspondence and decision time match; the positive EAL claim is supported and the negative claim is unsupported.
fixed_semantics.sample_fail: Both target correspondence and decision time match; the negative EAL claim is supported and the positive claim is unsupported.
fixed_semantics.unresolved: Target correspondence matches but admissible evidence does not decide pass or measured fail, or an external effect outcome is unknown.
fixed_semantics.out_of_scope: The available registered candidate does not correspond to the requested service, build, dataset, run, client workload, criteria, freshness contract, source revision or method. No requested-target assessment is asserted; claim statuses are null.

outcomes: Exact answer with justified scope and qualification
No false admission of different run/client workload
Logical external effect invocations under duplicate delivery
Committed delivery recovery without another external effect
All attempts, unknown outcomes and failures retained
cost: Count measured logical gateway invocations, actual EAL acquisition/reuse, transport bytes, ledger operations and native contexts. Native tokens/USD and implementation/onboarding cost remain unmeasured. No total-cost improvement claim.
analysis: Report software fault-injection and actual communicating-agent results separately. These are internal synthetic fixtures, not a representative benchmark. One paired native trial per case supports only those runs. Preserve the original /1 report and its scores.
